name: Tripodero
description: A fearsome critter of North American lumberjack folklore, native to the Californian chaparral. First described by William T. Cox in 1910 as a small, kangaroo-tailed creature with two telescopic legs and a blowgun-like snout that fires mud pellets at prey.
origin: Cox locates the Tripodero in the Californian chaparral and the foothills of the Sierra Nevada.
